title: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/teams?per_page=21
description: The teams with access to the repository that the caller can see, the first 21, so a 21st says there are more than the 20 kit draws, as the teams stage's in `modules/bash/forge/github.sh` (forge/github:teams, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::github_teams). A repository a user owns answers an empty list, and GitHub answers some who can reach the repository 404, whom its reference does not say. The types are those of GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/teams in GitHub's REST OpenAPI, https://github.com/github/rest-api-description, as https://docs.github.com/rest/repos/repos#list-repository-teams describes them.

permission.description: pull, triage, push, maintain, or admin; kit names pull read and push write.
